rows.note: Use 欄 as the all-purpose everyday term for a vertical table field or a text column on a page.

example.english: The first column of this table is for names.
example.traditional: 呢張表嘅第一欄係姓名。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 biu2 ge3 dai6 jat1 laan4 hai6 sing3 meng2

rows.note: Use 柱 for a solid upright pillar supporting a roof, beam, or other structure.

example.english: This pillar is sturdy and supports the whole house like a column.
example.traditional: 呢條柱好穩陣，頂住成間屋。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyu5 hou2 wan2 zan6 ding2 zyu6 seng4 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use 專欄 for a recurring newspaper or magazine feature, especially one associated with an author or theme.

example.english: I read his column every week.
example.traditional: 我每個星期都睇佢嗰篇專欄。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 tai2 keoi5 go2 pin1 zyun1 laan4

rows.note: Use 脊柱 for the anatomical spinal column or backbone as a vertical supporting structure.

example.english: Poor posture over time can make your spinal column hurt.
example.traditional: 長期坐姿唔啱，會令脊柱痛。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 co5 zi1 m4 ngaam1 wui5 ling6 zek3 cyu5 tung3
